package fixture

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net"
	"net/rpc"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime/schema"
	"k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache"
	fakelistwatch "k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache/testing"
	sieve "sieve.client"
)

type receipt struct{ operation, version, observer string }
type LearnListener struct {
	informers map[string]cache.SharedIndexInformer
	mutex     sync.Mutex
	pending   map[int]receipt
	finished  chan string
	failures  chan string
}

func (l *LearnListener) NotifyLearnBeforeControllerRecv(request *sieve.NotifyLearnBeforeControllerRecvRequest, response *sieve.Response) error {
	l.mutex.Lock()
	defer l.mutex.Unlock()
	var object metav1.PartialObjectMetadata
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(request.Object), &object); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if request.ResourceType != "secret" {
		l.failures <- "partial metadata was not identified as Secret"
	}
	observer := request.ObservedBy
	informer, known := l.informers[observer]
	if !known {
		l.failures <- "receipt has no independent informer observer"
		response.Ok = true
		return nil
	}
	previous, exists, err := informer.GetIndexer().GetByKey("default/example")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if exists && previous.(metav1.Object).GetResourceVersion() == object.ResourceVersion && request.OperationType != "Deleted" {
		l.failures <- "before receipt ran after the cache mutation"
	}
	response.Ok = true
	response.Number = len(l.pending)
	l.pending[response.Number] = receipt{request.OperationType, object.ResourceVersion, observer}
	return nil
}

func (l *LearnListener) NotifyLearnAfterControllerRecv(request *sieve.NotifyLearnAfterControllerRecvRequest, response *sieve.Response) error {
	l.mutex.Lock()
	defer l.mutex.Unlock()
	event, found := l.pending[request.EventID]
	if !found {
		l.failures <- "receipt completion has no matching start"
	}
	current, exists, err := l.informers[event.observer].GetIndexer().GetByKey("default/example")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if event.operation == "Deleted" {
		if exists {
			l.failures <- "deleted Secret is still cached after receipt"
		}
	} else if !exists || current.(metav1.Object).GetResourceVersion() != event.version {
		l.failures <- "after receipt did not observe the committed cache state"
	}
	response.Ok = true
	l.finished <- event.observer + "/" + event.operation
	return nil
}

func TestInformerReceiptsBracketRealCacheUpdates(t *testing.T) {
	source := fakelistwatch.NewFakeControllerSource()
	original := &metav1.PartialObjectMetadata{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "example", Namespace: "default"}}
	original.SetGroupVersionKind(schema.GroupVersionKind{Version: "v1", Kind: "Secret"})
	source.Add(original)
	informer := cache.NewSharedIndexInformer(source, original, 0, cache.Indexers{})
	fullSource := fakelistwatch.NewFakeControllerSource()
	fullOriginal := &corev1.Secret{ObjectMeta: original.ObjectMeta}
	fullSource.Add(fullOriginal)
	fullInformer := cache.NewSharedIndexInformer(fullSource, fullOriginal, 0, cache.Indexers{})
	listener := &LearnListener{informers: map[string]cache.SharedIndexInformer{"metadata-informer": informer, "informer": fullInformer}, pending: map[int]receipt{}, finished: make(chan string, 16), failures: make(chan string, 16)}
	server := rpc.NewServer()
	if err := server.RegisterName("LearnListener", listener); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	network, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer network.Close()
	go server.Accept(network)
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{
		"sieveServerAddr": network.Addr().String(), "crdList": []string{"secret"},
		"annotatedReconcileStackFrame": []string{"fixture.Reconcile"},
	})
	t.Setenv("sieveTestPlan", string(payload))
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	go informer.RunWithContext(ctx)
	go fullInformer.RunWithContext(ctx)
	await := func() string {
		t.Helper()
		select {
		case failure := <-listener.failures:
			t.Fatal(failure)
		case operation := <-listener.finished:
			return operation
		case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("cache changed without paired Sieve receipts")
		}
		return ""
	}
	awaitBoth := func(operation string) {
		t.Helper()
		wanted := map[string]bool{"informer/" + operation: true, "metadata-informer/" + operation: true}
		for range 2 {
			got := await()
			if !wanted[got] {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected or duplicate receipt: %s", got)
			}
			delete(wanted, got)
		}
	}
	// Both caches watch the same Secret. The initial list uses AtomicFIFO's
	// ReplacedAll path, and live updates/deletion retain each cache's observer.
	awaitBoth("Replaced")
	changed := original.DeepCopy()
	changed.Labels = map[string]string{"marker": "changed"}
	fullChanged := fullOriginal.DeepCopy()
	fullChanged.Data = map[string][]byte{"marker": []byte("changed")}
	source.Modify(changed)
	fullSource.Modify(fullChanged)
	awaitBoth("Updated")
	source.Delete(changed)
	fullSource.Delete(fullChanged)
	awaitBoth("Deleted")
	select {
	case failure := <-listener.failures:
		t.Fatal(failure)
	default:
	}
}

type TestCoordinator struct {
	entered  chan string
	release  chan struct{}
	finished chan string
}

func (c *TestCoordinator) NotifyTestBeforeControllerReadPause(request *sieve.NotifyTestBeforeControllerReadPauseRequest, response *sieve.Response) error {
	c.entered <- request.ResourceKey
	<-c.release
	response.Ok = true
	return nil
}

func (c *TestCoordinator) NotifyTestAfterControllerReadPause(request *sieve.NotifyTestAfterControllerReadPauseRequest, response *sieve.Response) error {
	c.finished <- request.ResourceKey
	response.Ok = true
	return nil
}

func readSecret(indexer cache.Indexer, finished chan bool) {
	_, found, _ := indexer.GetByKey("default/example")
	finished <- found
}

func TestReadPauseOnModernInformer(t *testing.T) {
	source := fakelistwatch.NewFakeControllerSource()
	object := &metav1.PartialObjectMetadata{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "example", Namespace: "default"}}
	object.SetGroupVersionKind(schema.GroupVersionKind{Version: "v1", Kind: "Secret"})
	informer := cache.NewSharedIndexInformer(source, object, 0, cache.Indexers{})
	added, deleted := make(chan struct{}, 1), make(chan struct{}, 1)
	_, err := informer.AddEventHandler(cache.ResourceEventHandlerFuncs{
		AddFunc:    func(interface{}) { added <- struct{}{} },
		DeleteFunc: func(interface{}) { deleted <- struct{}{} },
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	coordinator := &TestCoordinator{entered: make(chan string, 1), release: make(chan struct{}), finished: make(chan string, 1)}
	server := rpc.NewServer()
	if err := server.RegisterName("TestCoordinator", coordinator); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	network, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer network.Close()
	go server.Accept(network)
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{
		"sieveServerAddr": network.Addr().String(), "annotatedReconcileStackFrame": []string{"fixture.readSecret"},
		"actions": []interface{}{map[string]interface{}{
			"actionType": "pauseController", "pauseAt": "beforeControllerRead", "pauseScope": "secret/default/example",
			"trigger": map[string]interface{}{"definitions": []interface{}{map[string]interface{}{
				"condition":        map[string]interface{}{"conditionType": "onObjectDelete", "resourceKey": "secret/default/example"},
				"observationPoint": map[string]interface{}{"when": "beforeControllerRead"},
			}}},
		}},
	})
	t.Setenv("sieveTestPlan", string(payload))
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	go informer.RunWithContext(ctx)
	if !cache.WaitForCacheSync(ctx.Done(), informer.HasSynced) {
		t.Fatal("informer did not sync")
	}
	wait := func(channel <-chan struct{}) {
		t.Helper()
		select {
		case <-channel:
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("informer event missing")
		}
	}
	source.Add(object)
	wait(added)
	source.Delete(object)
	wait(deleted)
	// No successful Get happened before the final object was deleted. The
	// transaction instrumentation must retain its resource type for NotFound.
	result := make(chan bool, 1)
	go readSecret(informer.GetIndexer(), result)
	select {
	case key := <-coordinator.entered:
		if key != "secret/default/example" {
			t.Fatal("wrong pause scope: " + key)
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("empty cache read bypassed the pause")
	}
	select {
	case <-result:
		t.Fatal("read completed while held")
	default:
	}
	close(coordinator.release)
	select {
	case key := <-coordinator.finished:
		if key != "secret/default/example" {
			t.Fatal("wrong release scope: " + key)
		}
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("held read was not released")
	}
	if <-result {
		t.Fatal("instrumentation changed NotFound into a successful read")
	}
}
